introduction: Virginia unemployment insurance provides temporary support after qualifying unemployment. VEC reviews monetary, separation and weekly eligibility.
description: Virginia unemployment insurance provides temporary support after qualifying unemployment. VEC reviews monetary, separation and weekly eligibility.

sections.who: Wages, job-separation circumstances and continuing ability and availability for work affect entitlement. Follow applicable work-search instructions.
sections.get: Approved payments replace part of wages. The initial application does not replace weekly requests.
sections.docs:
• Identity and contact information.
  • Employer, work-date and wage records.
  • The reason work ended or hours changed.
sections.apply:
1. File

    Use VEC claimant self-service through the state unemployment page.

  2. Respond to questions

    Complete identity checks and any separation or wage inquiry.

  3. Certify weekly

    File after the week ends and accurately report earnings and eligibility information.
sections.after: Read all decisions and requests. VEC says to continue eligible weekly filing during an appeal.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using VEC eligibility; VEC claimant responsibilities; VEC appeals. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does a wage determination settle everything?
Separation and weekly requirements must also be met.
When do I file a weekly request?
After that week is over, following VEC instructions.
Should I keep filing during an appeal?
VEC instructs claimants to continue weekly filing.
Can one application cover later weeks?
